description: This PHP abstract class defines a base structure for serializing or transforming endpoint results within the OrangeHRM API v2. It manages associated metadata and relationship data, and enforces implementation of a normalization method for converting objects into arrays.

classes.name: AbstractEndpointResult
classes.description: An abstract class providing a blueprint for endpoint result serialization, including management of metadata and relationships, and requiring subclasses to implement normalization logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint result with a model class, data, and optional metadata and relationships, performing a class existence check.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to convert the result data into an associative array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns the metadata ParameterBag associated with this result.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets the metadata ParameterBag for this result.

methods.name: getRels
methods.description: Returns the relationships ParameterBag associated with this result.

methods.name: setRels
methods.description: Sets the relationships ParameterBag for this result.
